articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Morgan Stanley Builds Digital Asset And Private Market Fee Engines. Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) appointed Amy Oldenburg as Head of Digital Asset Strategy, signaling a deeper push into digital assets and crypto services across its institutional and wealth management platform. The firm also agreed to acquire private shares platform EquityZen, expanding its capabilities in providing access and liquidity in private markets. Together, these steps indicate a broader build out of products and infrastructure around emerging asset classes for Morgan Stanley... Related tickers mentioned: MS-PQ.
